description: Namur - Bâtiments is a dataset listed in Open Data Wallonie Bruxelles, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ville de Namur. Cartographie en ligne: les bâtiments sur le territoire de Namur avec la ou les adresses de ceux-ci. Coverage: Namur. The portal files it under Urbanisme, Patrimoine. Its keywords are Adresse, Maison, Bâtiment, Numéro, logexport, Cartographie. The portal shows 39,858 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2021-08-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support building stock, energy use and retrofit studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-odwb-be-portal.
